description: MainActivity.java for an Android app demonstrating effective navigation with tabs and ViewPager, including fragment management and intent handling.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing tab navigation and fragment display.

classes.name: AppSectionsPagerAdapter
classes.description: Adapter providing fragments for each primary section.

classes.name: LaunchpadSectionFragment
classes.description: Fragment launching other activities, demonstrating intent usage.

classes.name: DummySectionFragment
classes.description: Placeholder fragment displaying dummy text for sections.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets up ViewPager and tabs.

methods.name: onTabSelected
methods.description: Switches ViewPager page when a tab is selected.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns fragment for a given section index.

methods.name: getPageTitle
methods.description: Returns title for each section tab.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Creates view for fragments, inflates layouts, sets click listeners.
